l1_connect_account.title: Bring every site under the central plane
l1_connect_account.why: Sites that are not managed centrally are found broken by the people working there, and upgraded only when someone travels.
steps: List the sites, with what runs at each and how it connects.
Register each site with the central plane.
Confirm each site reports health and version centrally.
l1_connect_account.success: Every site in scope reports to the central plane.
